NAME_2 posted his acceptance on the 3rd of October.  The acceptance arrived on October 7.  On October 4, NAME_1 sold the tract in question to NAME_3 and mailed to NAME_2 notice of the sale. B: NAME_1's offer was effectively revoked by the sale of the tract of land to NAME_3 on the 4th of October.

Excellent. So NAME_2's acceptance was effective on October 3, even though it arrived on October 7. Now, what about the revocation of the offer? When can NAME_1 revoke the offer? Is it before the acceptance is effective or after?
The offer can be revoked at any time before the acceptance is effective.

No, because the acceptance was already effective on October 3, before the revocation.
